segments.text: Lahat ng sports, kita mo sa golf, kailangan nakatuto ka talaga, wala kang dapat isipin.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Even sa basketball, maglalaro ka, even sa bowling, mag-target mo, alam ni Anti-Commissioner Bongko yan, na focus talaga itong sports parati.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: So ibig sabihin, dapat po ay supportado ang ating mga athletes sa kanilang mga pangailangan, equipments, pagkain, allowances,

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: and of course, moral support ibigay natin sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sabi ko, malaking karangalan po ang daladala nila para sa ating parati tuwing nananalo sila.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Hindi po matutumbasan and we should be proud of it sa kanilang pagko-compete parati at daladala nila yung ating bandila.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: So salamat po sa inyong lahat. I'm so happy na nandito po kayo.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: I would also like to reiterate my full support for this agency.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: I would also like to thank the agencies and their respective mandates.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ito pong Gaban PSC. Both agencies play important and complementary roles in strengthening Philippine sports.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Magkaiba man po ang kanilang mandato, isa pong layunin ang mapalakas ang Philippine sports at mapangalagaan ang kapakanan po ng bawat atletang Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: We have seen the remarkable achievements of our Filipino athletes in various international competitions,

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: including the recently concluded 2026 Asian Games po sa Nagoya.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ako mismo ay pumunta po doon.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Hindi po sapat na purihin lang natin sila kapag nananalo at nag-uwi ng medalya.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: We must ensure that they receive adequate and sustained support from grassroots development to international competitions and even throughout their professional careers.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: We are prepared to support additional funding for programs that will directly benefit our athletes and strengthen sports development nationwide.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ang kapakanan ng ating mga atleta.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Again, I just ask the PSC and Gab to utilize your budgets prudently.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Gamitin lang po ito sa tama at huwag itong masayang.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Make sure na mapunta talaga ito sa ating mga atleta at sa pagpapalakas ng sports dito sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: With that, the budgets of the Philippine Sports Commission and the Games and Amusement Board are hereby submitted to plenary,

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Salamat po and congratulations sa inyo.
